comment: VWR-32: opening the 500 MB 3MF (generate.ts --size 500 --seed 1) through readInNodeWorker. capMB caps the whole process's peak RSS (host thread, worker heap and the off-heap file and result buffers) on every OS; run.ts gates it, plus host-thread CPU between two event-loop turns under 50 ms, counted through the turn after the worker returns. measured is written by run.ts --update, per OS. Wall event-loop delay is recorded, never gated. Blind spot: CPU time cannot see the host blocked while waiting off-CPU (Atomics.wait, sync I/O, lock waits); only wall delay shows that.
